name: CLT Chronicle Memories starter deck
author: DecompRecomp
description: The deck a new game starts with on the 'CLT Chronicle Memories' image. That image replaced the disc's starter deck pools with its own data, in a layout the game reads differently: the port cannot draw from them, so a new game would start with no cards. This writes the deck down instead, drawn from the image's own pools (the seven groups of 16, 16, 4, 1, 1, 1 and 1 cards they hold). Off by default: the cards are numbered as the image numbers them, so with another disc this would deal the wrong ones.
